Install ghost-runtime on Omarchy

Ghost daemon, API, CLI, and desktop/browser automation without the HUD

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add ghost-runtime
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.7.0-1:
    pacman -Qi ghost-runtime

Open and use ghost-runtime

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql ghost-runtime

Frequently asked questions

How do I install ghost-runtime on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add ghost-runtime. The download is 173.8 KB and it takes 503.9 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is ghost-runtime free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed Apache-2.0.

How do I uninstall ghost-runtime?

Run omarchy pkg drop ghost-runtime. It removes the package from your system.

What does ghost-runtime depend on?

The package declares 9 dependencies: at-spi2-core, bun, grim, hyprland, libnotify, qrencode, systemd, wl-clipboard, wtype. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is ghost-runtime in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as ghost-runtime (version 0.7.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. ferdousbhai makes it. Project site: https://github.com/ferdousbhai/ghost.
